summary: Tested all new features from plugin architecture evolution: Plugin endpoints, SOAP Plugin config page, Proxy Servers with SOCKS5 support, Downloads page, and SOAP Operations with API selector. All 19 backend tests passed. All UI tests verified successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: Plugin architecture is well-designed with proper base class (health_check, validate_config, config_schema)
PluginConfig has useful require() and validate() methods for configuration management
Proxy servers correctly handle SOCKS5 with optional authentication
Old /soap-apis route still accessible for backwards compatibility - consider adding a redirect
context_for_next_testing_agent: All plugin endpoints working correctly. SOAP Plugin configuration page at /plugins/soap displays plugin info, configured URLs, and config schema. Proxy Servers page supports HTTP and SOCKS5 types with optional authentication. SOAP Operations has API selector dropdown. Menu structure confirmed: SOAP APIs removed from Config section, SOAP Plugin added under Plugins menu.

plugins_endpoint_get_all.notes: Returns list of all registered plugins with config_schema

plugins_endpoint_get_soap_api.notes: Returns detailed plugin info including name, version, description, config_schema

plugins_health_check.notes: Health check returns healthy=false for unavailable SOAP service (expected)

plugins_validate_config.notes: Validates configuration and reports missing required fields

proxy_servers_type_support.notes: Proxy servers support HTTP and SOCKS5 types with optional username/password

soap_plugin_page.notes: New page displays plugin info card, configured URLs list, and config schema

plugins_menu_sidebar.notes: New Plugins menu in sidebar with SOAP Plugin submenu

soap_api_selector.notes: SOAP API dropdown selector shows configured APIs

soap_apis_removed_from_config.notes: SOAP APIs menu item no longer appears in Configuration section

downloads_page.notes: Page loads correctly with all buttons (Refresh, Clear Finished, Cancel All)

mocked_services.soap_web_service: External SOAP service is mocked/unavailable - health checks return healthy=false as expected
mocked_services.tika_ocr: Apache Tika OCR not running in preview environment
